verdict.why: Test names no longer include the column when includeTaskLocation is enabled, so output differs for existing config.

draft.detail: With --includeTaskLocation enabled, the verbose reporter will also include the location of each test in the output

test.error: FAIL: --includeTaskLocation printed the column after the line number

source.quote: The verbose reporter prints every test case once it is finished. It does not report suites or files separately. If `--includeTaskLocation` is enabled, it will also include the location of each test in the output.
